# Codivio

Codivio is a free online tools platform for QR codes, PDF files, images and
everyday digital tasks. This file is a supplementary, optional resource for
AI systems and other automated readers — it does not affect Google Search
ranking or indexing, and it does not guarantee visibility in any AI system.

Official domain: https://codivio.online/

## Languages

Codivio's interface supports Azerbaijani (AZ, default), Turkish (TR) and
English (EN).

## Public pages

- / — Homepage
- /tools — All tools, browsable by category
- /blog — Guides about QR codes, PDFs, images and productivity
- /faq — Frequently asked questions
- /about — About Codivio
- /contact — Contact Codivio
- /privacy — Privacy Policy
- /terms — Terms of Service
- /cookies — Cookie Policy

## Tool categories (34 tools total)

### QR Tools (12)
QR Code Generator, QR Code Scanner, URL to QR Code, Text to QR Code,
WiFi QR Code, vCard QR Code, Email QR Code, SMS QR Code, WhatsApp QR Code,
Phone QR Code, Location QR Code, Calendar QR Code

### PDF Tools (8)
PDF Merge, PDF Split, PDF Compress, PDF to JPG, JPG to PDF, PDF to Word,
PDF to Excel, PDF Rotate

### Image Tools (11)
Image Resize, Image Compress, Image Converter, JPG to PNG, PNG to JPG,
WebP Converter, Image Crop, Image Rotate, Background Remover,
Image to PDF, PDF to Image

### Other Tools (3)
GIF Maker, Meme Generator, Color Palette Generator

## Current status

All 34 tools listed above are in active development. Their pages describe
the tool's intended purpose and planned workflow; they do not yet perform
live file processing. Do not describe these tools as currently functional.
